import json
from runtime.kv_skap_vault import KVSkapVault, VaultRefusal, CUSTODY_REF_PREFIX, CREDENTIAL_AUTHORITY
rows = []
def probe(subject, fn):
    try:
        fn()
        rows.append({"subject": subject, "disposition": "ALLOW"})
    except VaultRefusal as exc:
        rows.append(dict({k: v for k, v in exc.fields.items() if isinstance(v, str)}, subject=subject, disposition="FAIL_CLOSED", raised="VaultRefusal"))
    except Exception as exc:
        rows.append({"subject": subject, "disposition": "EXCEPTION", "exception": type(exc).__name__})
ref = CUSTODY_REF_PREFIX + "ladder-probe"
def skap_bind():
    KVSkapVault("principal:ladder-probe").bind_custody_key_reference(custody_key_ref=ref, issued_by=CREDENTIAL_AUTHORITY, tvc_issuance_receipt_ref="probe:no-layer1-receipt")
def kv_read():
    v = KVSkapVault("principal:ladder-probe")
    v.bind_custody_key_reference(custody_key_ref=ref, issued_by=CREDENTIAL_AUTHORITY, tvc_issuance_receipt_ref="probe:x")
    c = v.grant_consent(purposes=["WRITE", "READ"], projection_ids=["p"], observed_at="probe")["receipt_hash"]
    v.write_projection(projection_id="p", content={"a": 1}, consent_receipt_hash=c, custody_key_ref=ref, intr_transition_ref="intr:not-a-receipt")
    v.read_projection(projection_id="p", consent_receipt_hash=c)
    return v, c
def reconstruct_read():
    v, c = kv_read()
    KVSkapVault.reconstruct(v.export_lineage()).read_projection(projection_id="p", consent_receipt_hash=c)
probe("SKAP_BIND_WITHOUT_LAYER1_KV_ACCESS_RECEIPT", skap_bind)
probe("KV_WRITE_READ_WITHOUT_HEALTHY_NODE_OR_VERIFIED_INTR", kv_read)
probe("KV_RECONSTRUCT_AND_READ_FROM_EXPORT_WITHOUT_INTR", reconstruct_read)
print(json.dumps({"rows": rows}, sort_keys=True))

import json, sys, tempfile
sys.path[:0] = [".", "tests"]
from runtime import kv_interlock_endpoint as ep
from runtime import kv_skap_vault as kv
from runtime.kv_skap_layer2 import kv_skap_transition
from kv_two_layer_e0 import TwoLayers, e0_health_ledger
from execution.adapter import canonical_sha256
from execution.vault_store import KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore, SKAP_KV_RECORD_SCHEMA
from execution.vault_store import SKAP_SEALED_FORMAT
import base64, hashlib
SIX = ("failure_code", "failed_predicate", "required_evidence_or_repair", "retry_entrypoint", "owning_existing_goal", "next_attempt")
rows = []
def row(subject, out, note=None):
    r = {"subject": subject}
    if isinstance(out, dict):
        d = out.get("disposition") or out.get("decision")
        r["disposition"] = "ALLOW" if d in ("ALLOW", "ALLOW_BOUNDED_CONTEXT") else d
        for k in SIX + ("failure_class",):
            if isinstance(out.get(k), str):
                r[k] = out[k]
    else:
        r["disposition"] = out
    if note: r["note"] = note
    rows.append(r)
def guard(subject, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except Exception as exc:
        f = getattr(exc, "fields", None)
        if isinstance(f, dict):
            row(subject, f, "raised %s carrying six fields" % type(exc).__name__)
        else:
            rows.append({"subject": subject, "disposition": "EXCEPTION", "exception": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:200]})
N = "device:probe:1"
def l1(subject, **kw):
    ev = kw.pop("access_kw", {})
    guard(subject, lambda: row(subject, TwoLayers(node=N, **kw).kv_access(**ev)))
l1("LAYER1_NO_LEDGER_BOUND", ledger_root=None)
l1("LAYER1_NO_HEALTH_REPORT_ON_LEDGER", ledger_root=e0_health_ledger(N, report=False)[0])
l1("LAYER1_UNHEALTHY_REPORT", ledger_root=e0_health_ledger(N, status="UNHEALTHY")[0])
l1("LAYER1_HEALTHY_BUT_NOT_ADMITTED", ledger_root=e0_health_ledger(N, admitted=False)[0])
l1("LAYER1_REPORT_FOR_ANOTHER_NODE", ledger_root=e0_health_ledger("device:other:9")[0])
l1("LAYER1_UNVERIFIED_BOUNDARY_PROOF", access_kw={"verification_state": "UNVERIFIED"})
l1("LAYER1_CALLER_ASSERTED_HEALTH_EVIDENCE", access_kw={"evidence": {"healthy": True}})
# observational: a scratch ledger the caller writes, plus a caller-asserted VERIFIED boundary proof naming that node
l1("LAYER1_CALLER_SUPPLIED_SCRATCH_LEDGER_AND_ASSERTED_IDENTITY")
def fake_eval(node_ref, **_):
    out = dict(ep._HEALTHY_RECEIPT_EXACT)
    out.update(node_id=node_ref, health_report_receipt_sha256="sha256:" + "c" * 64, chain_head_receipt_sha256="sha256:" + "d" * 64)
    return out
def injected():
    t = TwoLayers(node=N, evaluator=fake_eval, ledger_root=None)
    a = t.kv_access()
    row("LAYER1_INJECTED_NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", a)
    if a.get("kv_access_receipt"):
        h = a["kv_access_receipt"]["receipt_hash"]
        row("LAYER2_ON_LAYER1_RECEIPT_FROM_NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR",
            t.gate.admit(kv_skap_transition(principal_ref=t.principal, operation="SKAP_READ", subject_ref="p1", prior_receipt_hash=h)))
guard("LAYER1_INJECTED_NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", injected)
def l2():
    t = TwoLayers(node=N)
    tr = lambda prior, op="SKAP_READ": kv_skap_transition(principal_ref=t.principal, operation=op, subject_ref="p1", prior_receipt_hash=prior)
    row("LAYER2_WITHOUT_LAYER1_RECEIPT", t.gate.admit(tr(None)))
    row("LAYER2_ON_CALLER_MINTED_LAYER1_RECEIPT", t.gate.admit(tr("sha256:" + "a" * 64)))
    h = t.kv_hash()
    first = t.gate.admit(tr(h))
    row("LAYER2_ON_LAYER1_RECEIPT_FROM_PINNED_EVALUATOR", first)
    row("LAYER2_REUSED_LAYER1_RECEIPT", t.gate.admit(tr(h)))
guard("LAYER2_SEQUENCE", l2)
def bundle(secret):
    # a structurally valid sealed envelope with opaque bytes (no crypto dependency; KV never decrypts)
    s = {"format": SKAP_SEALED_FORMAT, "object_id": "skap://APIs/probe/v1", "credential_version": 1,
         "wrapping_policy_ref": "policy://skap/probe", "purpose": "probe", "endpoint_ref": "https://example.invalid",
         "key_authority_ref": "tvc://credential-root/test-only", "kdf_salt_b64": "c2FsdA==", "nonce_b64": "bm9uY2U=",
         "aad_hash": "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(secret).hexdigest(), "ciphertext_b64": base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(b"ct" + secret).digest()).decode(),
         "plaintext_persisted": False, "key_material_persisted": False, "authority_transfer": False}
    r = {"schema": "stegverse.skap.owner_credential_ingress_receipt/v1", "object_id": s["object_id"],
         "credential_version": s["credential_version"], "purpose": s["purpose"], "endpoint_ref": s["endpoint_ref"],
         "wrapping_policy_ref": s["wrapping_policy_ref"], "authorization_ref": "webauthn://probe", "source_class": "TRUSTED_INTERACTIVE_EDGE",
         "key_authority_ref": s["key_authority_ref"], "sealed_material_hash": canonical_sha256(s), "plaintext_length": len(secret),
         "owner_authorized": True, "plaintext_persisted": False, "device_durable_secret_custody": False,
         "kv_decryption_authority": False, "model_secret_access": False, "authority_transfer": False, "ingressed_at": "2026-10-23T00:00:00Z"}
    return s, r
def store_probe():
    t = TwoLayers(principal="principal:owner", node=N)
    acc = lambda op, sid: {"skap_gate": t.gate, "principal_ref": "principal:owner", "skap_access_receipt_hash": t.skap_hash(op, sid)}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        st = KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore(tmp)
        sealed, receipt = bundle(b"probe-credential-a")
        st.append_skap_sealed_credential("s1", sealed, receipt, **acc("SKAP_SEALED_CREDENTIAL_APPEND", "s1"))
        recs = [r for r in KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore(tmp).read_stream("Extensions", "s1") if r.get("schema") == SKAP_KV_RECORD_SCHEMA]
        row("SKAP_RECORD_READ_VIA_READ_STREAM_WITHOUT_LAYER2", "ALLOW" if recs and recs[-1]["sealed_material"] == sealed else "FAIL_CLOSED",
            "KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore.read_stream('Extensions', ...) returned the sealed SKAP record with no skap_gate and no SKAP-access receipt")
        forged, _ = bundle(b"probe-credential-forged")
        rec = {"schema": SKAP_KV_RECORD_SCHEMA, "object_id": forged["object_id"], "credential_version": forged["credential_version"],
               "sealed_material": forged, "sealed_material_hash": canonical_sha256(forged), "kv_decryption_authority": False,
               "kv_secret_resolution_authority": False, "plaintext_present": False, "key_material_present": False, "authority_transfer": False,
               "access": {"kv_access_receipt_hash": "sha256:" + "0" * 64, "skap_access_receipt_hash": "sha256:" + "0" * 64}}
        KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore(tmp).append_extension("s1", rec)
        back = st.read_skap_sealed_credential("s1", **acc("SKAP_SEALED_CREDENTIAL_READ", "s1"))
        row("SKAP_RECORD_WRITE_VIA_APPEND_EXTENSION_WITHOUT_LAYER2", "ALLOW" if back == forged else "FAIL_CLOSED",
            "append_extension wrote a SKAP sealed-credential record with no layer-2 receipt; the gated read then returned it" if back == forged else None)
guard("SKAP_STORE", store_probe)
print(json.dumps({"rows": rows}, sort_keys=True))
